title: Professor needs an assistant today
scenario: An email that appears to come from a professor says a research assistant dropped out and they need someone today. The job pays well and begins with depositing a check to buy equipment from a “preferred vendor.”

answers.A: Deposit the check but wait for it to show as available before buying the equipment.
answers.B: Verify the job with the professor or department through a separate university channel before depositing anything.
answers.C: Ask for the position to be posted through the university’s normal hiring system.

explanation: Fake checks can appear available before they are later reversed. The professor identity and purchasing process must be verified first.
proTip: “Funds available” is not the same as “check cleared.”
